name: ServerWatcher
author: me@ifamished.com
startup: pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -U serverwatcher && pip install -U hungerlib && python3 -m serverwatcher --init || true && python3 -m serverwatcher

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ServerWatcher Installer
# Server Files: /mnt/server

apt update
apt install -y python3 python3-pip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

pip install -U pip
pip install serverwatcher

echo "install complete"
exit 0
